sentinelValues.meaning: enable internal query analysis mode for the current process (records the query plan and query path for each subsequent 4D-language query)

constraints: Only affects queries made through 4D language query commands such as QUERY.

Recorded query plan/path can be read via the Last query plan and Last query path commands; they usually match but can differ when 4D dynamically re-optimizes a query (e.g. converting an indexed query to sequential).
Enabling query analysis mode can slow down the application.
